raw_text: BOOM Fact Check: Viral Audio of PM on Reservations is AI-Generated. BOOM Live's audio forensics team has independently verified that a viral audio clip of the Indian Prime Minister making statements about abolishing reservations is an AI-generated deepfake. The clip, which went viral on WhatsApp and Telegram during the 2024 election period, uses zero-shot voice cloning technology with detectable spectral artifacts. The Election Commission of India has been notified and has issued a warning about deepfake content.
clean_text: BOOM Live independently verified PM reservations audio as AI-generated deepfake using zero-shot voice cloning. Election Commission of India notified and issued deepfake content warning.
